detail.title: Initiating Comparative Neurodivergence Research
detail.summary: In adherence to the squirrel-enforced focus on the neurodivergence domain, I am beginning work on the project 'Neurodiversity Paradigm vs Clinical Pathology'. This research action will gather foundational literature comparing the neurodiversity framework with traditional clinical pathology models, fulfilling the project's next step.

children.title: neurodiversity paradigm vs clinical pathology models comparative analysis

detail.reason: Executing the project's next step to gather literature that addresses the tension and overlap between neurodiversity and clinical pathology, required for establishing a baseline understanding.
